```{r}
# Create hypo result dir
hypo.result.dir <- file.path("../../results/05_EQTm/EQTm_results/hypo/network/") 
dir.create(hypo.result.dir, recursive=TRUE)

# load data

hyper.result.dir <- file.path("../../results/05_EQTm/EQTm_results/hyper/network/") 
dir.create(hyper.result.dir, recursive=TRUE)

#load data
hyper <- read.csv(
  "../../results/05_EQTm/EQTm_results/hyper/hypermethylated_sig_gene_cpg_results.csv"
)%>% dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05)

write.csv(hyper, file.path(hyper.result.dir, "hyper_fdr_methylated_sig_gene_cpg_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

hyper
```


# Hypo-methylated CpGs and Regulated Genes

```{r}
df.meth.status.hypo <- hypo %>% # Re-structure code, for now I leave it as is
                          select(CpG.id, geneID, gene.symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
                          mutate(logFC = as.numeric(logFC)) %>%
                          filter(abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>%
                          arrange(desc(abs(logFC)))
```

```{r}
df.meth.status.hyper <- hyper %>% # Re-structure code, for now I leave it as is
                          select(CpG.id, geneID, gene.symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
                          mutate(logFC = as.numeric(logFC)) %>%
                          filter(abs(logFC) > 0.5) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val <= 0.05) %>%
                          arrange(desc(abs(logFC)))
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtree)
library(aplot)
library(dendextend)

# Reshape data to fill missing combinations with 0
df_wide <- df.meth.status.hyper %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = CpG.id,
    names_from = gene.symbol,
    values_from = logFC,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -CpG.id,
    names_to = "gene.symbol",
    values_to = "logFC"
  )

# Create heatmap with ggplot2
p <- ggplot(df_wide, aes(x = gene.symbol, y = CpG.id, fill = logFC)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "red",       # Color for lowest values
    mid = "grey",    # Color for midpoint (0)
    high = "blue",     # Color for highest values
    midpoint = 0       # Explicitly set midpoint to 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "CpG IDs",
    y = "Gene IDs",
    title = "LogFC Values by Gene and CpG ID (hyper-methylated)",
    fill = "LogFC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),  # Add major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.1)  # Add minor grid lines
  )

ggsave(
  filename =  file.path(hyper.result.dir, "hyper_methylation_heatmap.png"),
  p,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white", 
  device = "png")
```


```{r}
# Create nodes and edges data frames
edges <- data.frame(
  from = df.meth.status$CpG.id,  # CpG IDs
  to = df.meth.status$gene.symbol, # Gene IDs
  weight = df.meth.status$logFC         # Edge weights (e.g., correlation or significance)
)

id = c(unique(df.meth.status$CpG.id), df.meth.status$gene.symbol)
type = ifelse(grepl("cg", id), "CpG", "Gene")

nodes <- data.frame(
  id = id,
  type = type
)
nodes
```


```{r}
# Create a graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = TRUE) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight)) 

# Plot the graph
plot <- ggraph(graph, layout = "fr", weights = abs_weight) +  # Use absolute weights for layout
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = abs(weight), color = weight > 0), alpha = 0.6) +  # Color by weight sign
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 2) +  # Nodes colored by type
  geom_node_text(aes(label = id), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +  # Node labels
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2)) +  # Adjust edge width range
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "red")) +  # Set edge colors
  theme_void() +  # Clean theme
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "in"),  # Margin adjustments
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove edge color legend
  ) +
  labs(title = "hypo-methylated CpGs and Regulated Genes")

print(plot)

# Save the plot to a file with high quality (300 dpi)
ggsave(
  filename =  file.path(hypo.result.dir, "hypo_methylation_plot_fc02.png"),
  plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white", 
  device = "png")

```
